assignments.reason: This node's essential nature is Torah-as-shalom. The Torah text explicitly states 'הַתּוֹרָה הַנִּקְרֵאת שָׁלוֹם' — Torah IS called shalom (bechina language). Since שלום was already added to Package 1 in the additions file, and this node is the Torah-face of that same shalom identity, its essential nature belongs in Package 1 as part of the da'at-love-chesed-shalom cluster. Torah in this teaching is the garment of divine love (ahavah) and the pathway to shalom.

assignments.node_id: צדיקים שנקראו גם כן ברית שלום
assignments.reason: The tzaddikim are 'called brit shalom' — their essential nature in this Torah is that they ARE shalom, just as Torah IS shalom. The text parallels them: 'עַל-יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַנִּקְרֵאת שָׁלוֹם... וְעַל-יְדֵי צַדִּיקִים שֶׁנִּקְרְאוּ גַּם כֵּן בְּרִית שָׁלוֹם.' The tzaddik in section ה is also called 'tov' and 'or' — both equated with the hidden Torah. Their nature is the shalom/chesed/ahavah cluster of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: ימצא השם יתברך בין בטיבו בין בעקו
assignments.reason: Finding God in both good and bad circumstances is the essential expression of shalom in one's midot — the core teaching of section א. This is not a practice but a state of being: inner peace (shalom) with God through all conditions. Its nature is the da'at-awareness that God fills everything ('מְלֹא כָל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ'), which is the da'at dimension of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: לאהב את השלום בכל מקום הן בטיבו וכו, ויכול להיות שלום בין ישראל, ולאהב זה את זה:
assignments.reason: Loving peace in all circumstances and achieving peace among Israel — this is the interpersonal and communal expression of ahavah and shalom. Its essential nature is love (אהבה) and peace (שלום), both already core members of Package 1. This node describes the realized state of the ahavah-she-b'da'at in the social/communal dimension.

Tasting the light of the love-in-da'at is the direct experiential realization of the package's central concept. Its essential nature IS ahavah-she-b'da'at — this is Package 1's core identity stated as an experience. The 'or' (light) here is the hidden Torah-light ('אוֹר הַגָּנוּז'), and the ahavah is the chesed that runs through all the yamim/midot.

assignments.node_id: ה לגלות האהבה, שהוא החסד, שהוא יומא דאזל עם כלהו יומין. דהינו שהאהבה שהוא החסד מלבש בכל המדות וכו.
assignments.reason: This node describes the revelation of ahavah = chesed = 'the day that accompanies all days.' Its essential nature is ahavah and chesed, both already in Package 1. The proof text explicitly equates: 'הָאַהֲבָה, שֶׁהוּא הַחֶסֶד' — love IS chesed. This is the manifested form of Package 1's core reality.

assignments.node_id: ממשיך את האהבה מדעת, לתוך הימים ולתוך המדות. לראות טוב, ורואה ומשיג את האור כי טוב וגנוז. שמשיג האור, הינו התורה הגנוזה, והצדיקים הגנוזים
assignments.reason: Drawing love from da'at into the yamim/midot and perceiving the hidden light/Torah/tzaddikim — this is the culminating result of the entire Torah's teaching. Its essential nature is the ahavah-she-b'da'at flowing into the midot, which is precisely the Package 1 identity. The hidden Torah and hidden tzaddikim are both called 'tov' and 'or,' equated with da'at and ahavah.

assignments.node_id: מקבלין המדות אור האהבה שבדעת וכו
assignments.reason: The midot receiving the light of ahavah-she-b'da'at is the essential dynamic of Package 1. This is not merely a causal result — it is what ahavah-she-b'da'at IS when it reaches the level of the midot. Its nature is the da'at-love illumination that defines the package.

new_packages.label: כְּפִיַּת הַיֵּצֶר — קִשּׁוּר הַלֵּב לְהַדַּעַת
new_packages.label_en: Subduing the Yetzer — Connecting Heart to Da'at
new_packages.reason: These nodes all describe the active spiritual practice/discipline of overcoming the evil inclination and connecting the heart to da'at. While they produce effects in Package 1's domain (revealing ahavah-she-b'da'at), their own essential nature is the practice of self-mastery and inner alignment — the human effort of כפיית היצר and קישור לב לדעת. The Torah treats this as a distinct thematic domain: the person who subdues their yetzer is 'like an angel of God' (דומה למלאך ה' צבאות), builds Torah letters (עושה ובונה אותיות התורה), and specifically conquers the 'evil days' (ימי רע). This is the active/practical pole of the Torah's teaching, distinct from the metaphysical reality (Package 1) it unlocks. The variants (כפית היצר, שכופה את יצרו, etc.) are different formulations of the same essential practice.

new_packages.label: גִּלּוּי אוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה — בִּטּוּל הָרָע
new_packages.label_en: Revelation of Torah Letters — Nullification of Evil
new_packages.reason: These nodes describe the cosmic-revelatory result of subduing the yetzer: the evil that conceals Torah letters is nullified, and the letters become prominent and luminous. Their essential nature is the process of Torah-revelation from within concealment — the letters of Torah emerging from the klipot and receiving abundant light from above. This is distinct from Package 1 (the metaphysical reality of ahavah-she-b'da'at) and from new_1 (the practice of subduing the yetzer). It is the intermediate revelatory domain: what happens to the Torah letters themselves when evil is subdued. The Torah devotes sections ג-ד to this process as a distinct thematic layer.
nodes: אותיות התורה בולטין ומצטרפין. אזי הוא בחינות נעשה ונשמע, כי עושה ובונה אותיות התורה, וזוכה למשמע קול התורה מלעלא
הוא מדבר עם העכו"ם או שרואה מדותיהם, אזי תכף הרע ששוכן על הטוב הינו אותיות התורה, נתבטל ונופל, ואותיות התורה בולטין, אזי הוא יודע התורה שבאותו הדבר:
רע נתבלבל לגמרי נגד ימי הטוב שבהם, אזי אותיות בולטות ונתראים ומאירים ביותר
